basic_info.description: Discover this distinctive New York-style loft located in the heart of NOPA, just steps from the lively Divisadero corridor and Alamo Square. This two-bedroom, 1.5-bathroom home stands out with its airy 17-foot ceilings, spiral staircase, and a classic stove fireplace. The open living space extends to a private patio, and the unit is equipped with stainless appliances and in-unit laundry. Enjoy the convenience of an attached garage parking space, plus building amenities that include a shared roof deck with city views and a tranquil backyard. This pet-friendly residence offers a unique and compelling city living experience in an unmatched central San Francisco location.
